title: Review of c14's pcell-mwall (SIBDH): replicated on seed 5: M wall layer rim/core 3.28 on 120/131 cells, 12 persistent splits, yield selected by intrinsic deaths (death percentile 0.025 vs marker 0.55, birth rank 0.21 vs 0.46)
summary: Fresh labkit run of the claim's world.py on seed 5 (128^2, T=100000) and the claim's genealogy.py, deathsel.py and birthfate.py on the same seed (minlife 20). From the unstructured soup, ~20 cells form by t=4000 and the population stays at 21-24 cells to t=100000 (no giant body on this seed). labkit: M wall material rim/core 3.28, rim/outside 3.88, 120/131 individuals membrane-like; 19 splits, 8 persistent, generation 2, merge/split 0.16. Genealogy: 12 persistent splits, generation 2, 0 merges, 35 deaths (none imposed), 0 off-kind daughters, 0 conversions. Mean cell yield rises 1.00 -> 1.14 while the identical-event marker drifts to 0.95. Dying cells (n=17) sit at yield percentile 0.025 (all 17 below the median) against 0.549 for the marker; dying cells born after the founders had birth rank 0.205 in yield (marker 0.458), and low-born cells died more often than high-born ones (0.50 vs 0.17; marker 0.43 vs 0.33). Splits are not selected (percentile 0.46).

verdicts.limitation: The M layer is passive (no feedback on phi, links or particles), an adsorption ring up the wall indicator: it qualifies as a material layer but does no work. Kinds are ranks of a continuous capped trait. Generation reaches only 2 on this seed; the birth-rank signal rests on the cells that died after the founders (n~12-15). One fresh seed; no dt or resolution test.
